::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Feb 24 1890  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Girton College Cambridge, Yonge IV 17
:::

Dear [Mr Innes](people/person_744.qmd)
I have the Unfashionable Concert somewhere it is one of those things that if they cannot be put in at once, get set aside for fresher papers of the charity kind  I can’t make any promises about putting it in so I think I had better return it. I hoped to have found it this evening , but a visitor, and twilight prevented me. I have grown more wary at last about taking things that would overcrowd[^1]

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: *[MP](organizations/other_52.qmd)* frequently included advertisements for charities and fund-raising events.
